{
  "dataset_name": "mushroom",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "odor_severity_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Continuous severity score for odor based on known unpleasantness ordering (foul/creosote/pungent/musty/fishy/spicy strong; almond/anise mild; none neutral).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ordinal_encoding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a smooth scalar projection of the highly informative odor attribute suitable for linear margin separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(odor=='f', 1.0, np.where(odor=='c', 0.95, np.where(odor=='p', 0.9, np.where(odor=='m', 0.85, np.where(odor=='y', 0.75, np.where(odor=='s', 0.7, np.where(odor=='n', 0.2, np.where(odor=='a', 0.05, np.where(odor=='l', 0.05, 0.5)))))))))"
    },
    {
      "name": "spore_print_risk_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Smooth severity score for spore-print-color based on typical distribution skew (chocolate/white more concerning, buff/yellow/orange less so).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ordinal_encoding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth ordinal projection of a strongly discriminative categorical attribute for linear SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(spore_print_color=='h', 0.9, np.where(spore_print_color=='w', 0.65, np.where(spore_print_color=='k', 0.45, np.where(spore_print_color=='n', 0.4, np.where(spore_print_color=='r', 0.85, np.where(spore_print_color=='u', 0.3, np.where(spore_print_color=='b', 0.2, np.where(spore_print_color=='o', 0.15, np.where(spore_print_color=='y', 0.25, 0.5)))))))))"
    },
    {
      "name": "gill_narrow_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Binary indicator that gill_size is narrow, a known risk signal in mushroom identification.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "binary_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Crisp linear feature aligned with a strongly discriminative binary attribute.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(gill_size=='n', 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "gill_color_rarity_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Severity score for gill_color emphasizing buff (often associated with risk) and rare colors like green.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ordinal_encoding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth ordinal mapping of gill_color levels suited for linear projection.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(gill_color=='b', 0.95, np.where(gill_color=='r', 0.8, np.where(gill_color=='y', 0.3, np.where(gill_color=='p', 0.4, np.where(gill_color=='w', 0.45, np.where(gill_color=='n', 0.4, np.where(gill_color=='g', 0.35, np.where(gill_color=='h', 0.5, np.where(gill_color=='u', 0.45, np.where(gill_color=='k', 0.4, np.where(gill_color=='e', 0.3, np.where(gill_color=='o', 0.3, 0.5))))))))))))"
    },
    {
      "name": "stalk_root_missing_flag",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator that stalk_root is missing ('?'), capturing information about unobservable root which correlates with identification difficulty.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "missingness_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linear features benefit from explicit missingness flag separating clusters.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(stalk_root=='?', 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "stalk_surface_silkiness",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average silky-surface tendency on stalk (above and below ring), where 'k' (silky) is the high-risk surface texture.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "weighted_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Continuous composite over two related columns to improve linear margin stability.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where(stalk_surface_above_ring=='k', 1.0, np.where(stalk_surface_above_ring=='y', 0.6, np.where(stalk_surface_above_ring=='f', 0.3, 0.0))) + np.where(stalk_surface_below_ring=='k', 1.0, np.where(stalk_surface_below_ring=='y', 0.6, np.where(stalk_surface_below_ring=='f', 0.3, 0.0)))) / 2.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "stalk_color_consistency",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator that stalk color above and below ring match, capturing morphological homogeneity.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "consistency",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Binary consistency signal contributes a clean separating dimension for the linear margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(stalk_color_above_ring==stalk_color_below_ring, 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "bruises_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Binary indicator that the mushroom shows bruises.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "binary_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Direct linear projection of a clean binary attribute.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(bruises=='t', 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "ring_type_complexity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal severity scale for ring_type with pendant/evanescent low, large/flaring elevated, none high.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ordinal_encoding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth ordinal embedding of ring_type for linear separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(ring_type=='n', 1.0, np.where(ring_type=='l', 0.75, np.where(ring_type=='f', 0.6, np.where(ring_type=='e', 0.4, np.where(ring_type=='p', 0.2, 0.5)))))"
    },
    {
      "name": "habitat_population_risk",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted composite combining habitat and population density into a continuous risk score (urban/waste/paths high, abundant/numerous populations elevated).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "weighted_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Continuous additive composite provides a useful ranking dimension for linear models.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where(habitat=='u', 0.9, np.where(habitat=='p', 0.7, np.where(habitat=='l', 0.6, np.where(habitat=='w', 0.55, np.where(habitat=='g', 0.45, np.where(habitat=='d', 0.35, np.where(habitat=='m', 0.3, 0.5)))))))) + (np.where(population=='v', 0.7, np.where(population=='y', 0.55, np.where(population=='s', 0.45, np.where(population=='c', 0.4, np.where(population=='n', 0.35, np.where(population=='a', 0.25, 0.5)))))))"
    },
    {
      "name": "veil_color_anomaly",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator that veil_color deviates from the dominant white, signaling unusual specimens.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "anomaly_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linear separation benefit from flagging rare veil colors.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(veil_color=='w', 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "overall_edibility_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic risk assessment combining odor pleasantness, spore print, gill characteristics, and ring type into a holistic interpretable score where lower implies more typical benign morphology and higher implies suspicious morphology.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_judgment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "A holistic interpretable composite that captures non-linear field-guide heuristics as a single smooth scalar useful for linear SVM margins.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
